record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare PROTECT: Deoxys (Defense Forme) (DEOXYS_DEFENSE, 3 stars, maxPP 100, passive ALIEN_DNA) and Kabuto (1 star, maxPP 80, no passive); both range 1. The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star index into the duration table. Units not listed are not covered.
record.summary: Self-buff. After the base PP spend, the caster gets the Protect status for a requested duration of round(flatDuration x (2 + AP/100) x (crit ? 1 + (critPower - 1) x 0.5 : 1)) ms with flatDuration = [500, 1500, 2500, 4000][stars - 1] (4000 fallback), with table 500 / 1500 / 2500 / 4000 (4000 as fallback) and critFactor 1 + (critPower - 1) x 0.5 when the cast crit, else 1. At AP 0 and no crit that is 1000 ms (Kabuto, 1 star) and 5000 ms (Deoxys Defense, 3 stars); a 1-star caster with AP 100, critPower 2 and a crit requests round(500 x 3 x 1.5) = 2250 ms. triggerProtect does nothing if the caster is already protected (no refresh, no extension) or enraged, so the requested duration is only applied when neither holds. The strategy inherits requiresTarget = true: the cast needs a target in range even though the target is never used. On the paths cited in this record, a protected caster takes no damage from basic attacks (unsuccessful) or ability damage (handleSpecialDamage returns early; handleDamage returns takenDamage 0), positive PP gain is dropped and ordinary healing returns 0 / 0 (the wound branch of handleHeal runs before that guard; core-mechanics.md section J). Those are the paths that were read: this record does not claim that Protect blocks every other status application, forced or voluntary movement, item effect or direct HP writer. Protect is the status.protect flag; Rune Protect (status.runeProtect) is a different flag and neither blocks PP / healing nor implies Protect.

targeting.note: requiresTarget is inherited (true), so the unit must have a target in range to cast; the target parameter is passed to process and used only for the animation coordinates in the base class, never by ProtectStrategy.

declaredRaw.label: raw flat duration table (ms), before the AP factor (2 + AP/100) and crit

effects.scaling: requested duration = round(table[stars-1] x (2 + AP/100) x (crit ? 1 + (critPower - 1) x 0.5 : 1)); the AP factor is 2 + AP/100, so at AP 0 the raw table value is doubled (KABUTO 1000 ms, DEOXYS_DEFENSE 5000 ms). The crit branch needs ABILITY_CRIT because canCritByDefault is false; with critPower 2 the crit factor is 1.5. This is a duration, not a stat or heal amount, so Big Eater Belt and Twist Band do not apply.
effects.resolution: requested duration -> triggerProtect(timer): ignored when the caster is already protected (no refresh) or enraged; otherwise protect = true and protectCooldown = timer. updateProtect(dt) runs on each status update while protect is true and clears the flag when protectCooldown - dt <= 0, so the applied length is the requested duration in simulation time, rounded to update steps. Applied = requested when the guard passes, otherwise nothing.

effects.target: the caster, for as long as status.protect is true

declaredRaw.description: damage, ability damage, positive PP and ordinary healing blocked

effects.scaling: none from stars, AP or crit
effects.resolution: basic attack on the protected unit: isAttackSuccessful false, damage 0 (PokemonState.attack). Ability damage: handleSpecialDamage returns early (spellBlockedCount++) and handleDamage returns death false / takenDamage 0. Positive PP: addPP drops the value (negative PP values are not blocked by this flag). Ordinary healing: handleHeal skips its main branch when hp > 0 and protect is set and returns healReceived 0 / overheal 0; the wound branch earlier in handleHeal is not governed by this flag (core-mechanics.md section J, probe SHARED_HELPERS: Protect returns 0 / 0, Rune Protect alone does not). This is the shared status.protect behaviour; it is not an effect of Rune Protect (a different flag, set by triggerRuneProtect, which triggerProtect does not consult). The five paths listed are the ones read; other damage, status, movement or HP-writing paths were not traced and are not claimed to be blocked.

statusEffects.resolution: not stackable, not applied to an enraged caster, no refresh; ends in updateProtect
statusEffects.guards: triggerProtect does nothing when the caster already has Protect (no refresh, no extension) or is enraged; Rune Protect on the caster is not consulted
statusEffects.applicationOrder: after the base PP spend; the only effect of the strategy
statusEffects.combatEffect: status.protect is the flag tested by the cited damage, PP and healing paths (see effects[1]); it ends in updateProtect when protectCooldown - dt <= 0. Other paths were not traced.

starBehavior.note: The table index is the casting entity's stars at cast time. The 1500 (2 stars) and 4000 (4 stars / fallback) entries are declared in the table but unused by the two bound baseline classes. Kabuto declares stars 1 and evolves to Kabutops, which is not covered here. Whether other mechanics change an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: None. Self-cast; the only positional requirement is the inherited requiresTarget (a target in range).
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state beyond the status. A cast while protect is still active spends PP and counts as a cast but does not extend or refresh the duration (triggerProtect refuses). A cast while enraged also applies nothing.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: 500 / 1500 / 2500 / 4000 ms by stars (500 for KABUTO, 2500 for DEOXYS_DEFENSE). Requested duration = raw x (2 + AP/100) x critFactor, rounded: 1000 ms and 5000 ms at AP 0 without crit. Applied duration = requested when the caster is neither protected nor enraged, otherwise 0 change. Raw flat duration 500 / 1500 / 2500 / 4000 ms; computed request round(flat x (2 + AP/100) x crit factor), e.g. 1000 ms, 5000 ms and 2250 ms for the three examples above; stored length = the request only when the caster is neither protected nor enraged. While protected, the cited damage paths return 0 and request nothing against HP; no universal claim about other paths is made.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, silence, target acquisition for a requiresTarget ability) - only the castAbility gate was read
The ALIEN_DNA passive of DEOXYS_DEFENSE was not examined; whether it alters AP, stars or the cast is not covered here
Protect effects on other damage paths not listed here (status application, displacement, item effects) were not traced
unresolved: Whether the effect of protect on forced displacement, targeting or status-application paths beyond the five cited blocks (basic attack, handleSpecialDamage, handleDamage, handleHeal, addPP) matters was not traced
Exact timing granularity of updateProtect (the dt passed per status update) was not examined, so the real-time length is the requested duration only up to update-step rounding
Whether the two units reach a different star count than the factory value (evolution, merging) was not examined
No routing uncertainties were queued for this record

Evidence: source reading, mechanical checks and executed probes. The pinned helper text (triggerProtect, updateProtect, addPP, handleHeal, handleDamage) and the real ProtectStrategy strategy text were run against stand-in units and boards with controlled callbacks (probes/pinned-helper-probe.mjs, sections SHARED_HELPERS and IMPORT_RECHECK_3); the whole ability in a real fight, targeting and timing before the cast, and full battles were NOT executed, and nothing was observed in a live game. Executed (stand-in caster): Kabuto 1000 ms, Deoxys Defense 5000 ms, 2250 ms for 1 star / AP 100 / critPower 2 / crit; requiresTarget true; an existing Protect keeps its remaining time; an enraged caster gets none; Rune Protect on the caster changes nothing.
